name: html-output
description: Makes Claude Code and Codex write plans, specs, reports, and other documents meant for you as HTML files instead of Markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Documents meant for you are written as HTML files, not Markdown
interface.longDescription: Adds a standing instruction that makes the agent write plans, specs, design docs, option comparisons, reports, and handoffs as single HTML files with mockups and diagrams, and a skill with detailed guidance for review documents, throwaway editors, and a design system page.
